tone.target: jangly clean chorus pop with bright compressed edge
tone.profile: jangly clean chorus pop with bright compressed edge
tone.summary: A shimmering, compressed signal chain built around a clean Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) with Chorus and light Room reverb to achieve the signature jangly pop texture of The Cure.

rig.name: The Cure - In Between Days - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide tight attack and even sustain for the compressed jangle sound.
Create the signature shimmering, watery chorus effect essential for pop jangle.
Keep the signal clean and transparent to maintain jangle pop character.
Simulate the clean, bright Fender-style tone required for jangly pop.
Provide a bright and articulate cabinet sound matching the clean US Deluxe amp.
Enhance the bright top end and cut unnecessary low-end mud.
Add subtle space and shimmer without sounding overly wet or distracting.
Avoid heavy delay as per the 'avoid' list and focus on shimmer/chorus.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to enhance the bright, articulate jangle pop sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance clarity and brightness for jangly clean tones.
